newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech prelim Oct real ind output +5.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Czech prelim Oct real ind output +5.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Czech preliminary real industrial output in October rose 5.6 percent, year-on-year, putting output 8.1 percent higher for the January-October period, the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) said on Friday.
INDUSTRIAL OUPUT OCT 96 SEPT 96 OCT 95 JAN-OCT 96
AVERAGE INDUST WAGES OCT 96 SEPT 96 OCT 95 JAN-OCT 96

Note. Final October output/wage results are scheduled to be released on December 10. Wage results are taken from a survey of 210 firms with 100 or more employees. Production results also contain estimates from firms with up to 100 workers, as well as physical persons registered in the trades offices.
